C1504.title: Synthesizing Sensor Spoofing Attacks via Program Analysis
C1504.summary: A 2017 study proposes using program analysis to synthesize sensor spoofing attacks automatically. Given a target control program and desired unsafe state, the framework generates sensor-reading trajectories that drive execution along a chosen path. In a case study, researchers converted synthesized readings into forged wireless signals and injected them into sensors, showing that manipulated physical inputs can induce unsafe system behavior.
